'''Ploob'''<ref name="theguywhocreatedploob">{{Twitter|Paul_Dini|status/1164368088441053185|[[Paul Dini]]|quote=Ploob.|archivefile=File:PloobName.png}}</ref><ref name="Subtitles">[[Disney+]] subtitles for "[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]]"</ref> was a monster employed at [[Horville's Hut of Horrors]]. He looked like a small green ball with a long tube-like nose and hair along his spine.<ref name="HHOH" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] episode "[[Horville's Hut of Horrors (episode)|Horville's Hut of Horrors]]," Ploob only appeared for a short time while [[Horville]] was talking to [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and in Wicket's dream.<ref name="HHOH" />
